name: @bind/node
description: Bind Node.js SDK core transport and logging client

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('.test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.test:esm: node --input-type=module -e "import * as mod from './dist/esm/index.js'; if (typeof mod.createTransport !== 'function' || typeof mod.init !== 'function' || typeof mod.Severity !== 'object' || typeof mod.log !== 'object' || typeof mod.log.info !== 'function' || typeof mod.createLogger !== 'function' || typeof mod.CallSiteResolver !== 'function') { throw new Error('ESM exports check failed'); }"
scripts.test:cjs: node -e "const mod = require('./dist/cjs/index.js'); if (typeof mod.createTransport !== 'function' || typeof mod.init !== 'function' || typeof mod.Severity !== 'object' || typeof mod.log !== 'object' || typeof mod.log.info !== 'function' || typeof mod.createLogger !== 'function' || typeof mod.CallSiteResolver !== 'function') { throw new Error('CJS exports check failed'); }"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:compile && node --test .test-dist/test/*.test.js && npm run test:esm && npm run test:cjs
